body:
> As you can see, the animation sub-resources in the scene change order to conform the alphabetical order.

Correction: animation sub-resources are saved in the order of the '_data' fields in 'AnimationLibrary'. For example, this file was written by the editor:

```
[sub_resource type="Animation" id="Animation_y32ns"]
resource_name = "A anim"
step = 0.1

[sub_resource type="Animation" id="Animation_wtcfe"]
resource_name = "C anim"
step = 0.1

[sub_resource type="Animation" id="Animation_0e48y"]
resource_name = "B anim"
step = 0.1

[sub_resource type="AnimationLibrary" id="AnimationLibrary_wtcfe"]
_data = {
&"A lib": SubResource("Animation_y32ns"),
&"C lib": SubResource("Animation_wtcfe"),
&"Z lib": SubResource("Animation_0e48y")
}
```

Note that the key names in the AnimationLibrary may differ from the resource names in the Animation sub_resources.

Would sorting animations each time a `_data` structure is created solve the problem? Here:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/0fdbf050e0c7fc7e0a9d42c2a41ee3bfdffbd8f1/scene/resources/animation_library.cpp#L127-L135
